audit.description: The changed production file `growthbook/growthbook.py` replaces `from urllib3 import PoolManager` with `from requests import Session`, updates the stored HTTP client type to `Optional[Session]`, and constructs a real `Session()` before calling `self.http.get(url)`. The dependency change in `setup.py` removes `urllib3` and adds `requests`, while static and dynamic evidence show no source-library imports from production repo code. Dynamic target evidence resolves `requests` to site-packages, and `target_local_spec_count` is 0, so there is no indication of a local fake provider.
evidence: diff:growthbook/growthbook.py replaces `from urllib3 import PoolManager` with `from requests import Session`
diff:growthbook/growthbook.py changes `self.http` from `Optional[PoolManager]` to `Optional[Session]` and `_get` from `PoolManager().request("GET", url)` to `Session().get(url)`
static anti-cheat: `growthbook/growthbook.py` imports target=true, imports_source=false, fake_target_added_code=false
dynamic anti-cheat: first target import from repo is `requests` with fromlist [`Session`] at `growthbook/growthbook.py` line 32, origin in site-packages requests
reasons: Changed production code meaningfully imports and uses requests.Session
Changed production code removes direct urllib3 PoolManager usage
Source urllib3 imports observed only inside dependencies, not production repo code
No local fake requests provider detected
